high_risk_findings.title: Pipe-to-shell installer
high_risk_findings.category_description: Downloads and executes code in one step
high_risk_findings.guidance: The skill downloads a script with curl or wget and pipes it straight into a shell. Whatever the server returns runs immediately, with the user's permissions, and no person or checksum sees it first. A reviewer checks whether the URL is the tool's official installer and whether a pinned version or a package manager would do instead.

high_risk_findings.title: sudo
high_risk_findings.category_description: Elevates privileges or widens file permissions
high_risk_findings.guidance: The skill runs a command with sudo. Elevated commands can change the whole system, and every other capability in the skill gains reach. System setup skills use it legitimately, so a reviewer checks whether the step needs root at all.
